description.zh:
持续时间（单位：分钟），一次定时弹性任务持续的时间。

> 入参不少于15分钟。
description.en:
The duration (unit: minutes) of a scheduled elastic task.

> The parameter value must be at least 15 minutes.

description.zh:
启用或禁用定时任务策略。取值范围如下：

- **true**：启用。
- **false**：禁用。
description.en:
Enables or disables the scheduled task policy. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables the policy.
- **false**: Disables the policy.

description.zh:
开始执行定时策略时间。

如果是单次调度的策略类型，需要保证开始执行时间晚于当前时间30分钟以上。



><notice>为避免服务端不停地执行升配、降配任务，不同定时任务之间的时间间隔要至少大于 60 分钟。></notice>
description.en:
The time when the scheduled policy starts to execute.

For a one-time scheduling policy type, the start execution time must be more than 30 minutes later than the current time.

><notice>

To avoid the service from continuously executing upgrade and downgrade tasks, the time interval between different scheduled tasks must be at least 60 minutes.

</notice>
The region ID of the instance.

description.zh:
当 ScheduleType 为 repeat 时则需要填写参数，枚举值为
      <li> Daily：每天定时调度。
      <li> Weekly：每周定时调度。
description.en:
When ScheduleType is set to repeat, you need to fill in this parameter. Enumeration values are:

- Daily: Daily scheduled task.

- Weekly: Weekly scheduled task.

description.zh:
定时弹性预留生产规格（单位：MB/s）。

> ReservedPubFlow 和 ReservedSubFlow 入参必须至少有一个高于当前规格。
description.en:
The scheduled elastic reserved production specification (unit: MB/s).

> At least one of the ReservedPubFlow and ReservedSubFlow parameters must be higher than the current specification.

description.zh:
定时弹性预留消费规格（单位：MB/s）。
> ReservedSubFlow 和 ReservedPubFlow 入参必须至少有一个高于当前规格。
description.en:
The scheduled elastic reserved consumption specification (unit: MB/s).

> At least one of the ReservedSubFlow and ReservedPubFlow parameters must be higher than the current specification.

description.zh:
定时策略规则名称。

> 不可以与同实例其他规则名称重复。
description.en:
The name of the scheduled policy rule.

> The name cannot be the same as other rule names for the same instance.

description.zh:
定时类型。取值如下：

- at ：只调度一次。

-  repeat：重复调度。
description.en:
The schedule type. Valid values:

- at: Scheduled only once.
- repeat: Scheduled repeatedly.

description.zh: 每周的类型。支持多日重复执行。
description.en: The weekly types. Supports execution on multiple days.

descriptions.zh: ###### 仅支持 serverless 系列实例。
descriptions.en: ###### This operation supports only serverless instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka create-scheduled-scaling-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_serverless-cn-vxxxxxxxx --rule-name test --reserved-pub-flow 120 --reserved-sub-flow 120 --schedule-type at --duration-minutes 60 --time-zone GMT+8 --first-scheduled-time 1714467540000 --enable true --repeat-type Weekly --weekly-types Monday --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alikafka CreateScheduledScalingRule --region cn-hangzhou --ScheduleType at --ReservedPubFlow 120 --ReservedSubFlow 120 --TimeZone 'GMT+8' --InstanceId 'alikafka_serverless-cn-vxxxxxxxx' --DurationMinutes 60 --FirstScheduledTime 1714467540000 --Enable true --RepeatType Weekly --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --WeeklyTypes '["Monday"]' --RuleName test
